contact.basis: Exterior point5m west of actual principal west front selected before terrain/geometry; not a surveyed stair or building floor datum.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Eden Hotel frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1.5625m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Coarse urban composite may contain building/canopy artefacts and does not resolve the building foundation or street thresholds. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
